title: Frailty in Patient Undergoing Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Closure.
official: Frailty in Patient Undergoing Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Closure The Frail-LAAC Study
summary: To assess the prevalence and severity of frailty in patients undergoing LAAC, as well as its association to peri-procedural and long-term outcomes and quality of life.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Transcatheter LAAC with any approved device
* Age ≥18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to provide informed consent
* Severe neuropsychiatric impairment
